question: According to the review on water quality as a barrier to photocatalytic green hydrogen, what share of the world's hydrogen is still produced from fossil fuels, and in what year did Fujishima and Honda report photoelectrochemical water splitting?
rendered: According to the review, nearly 95% of the world's hydrogen is still produced from fossil fuels through processes such as steam methane reforming and coal gasification. However, the year in which Fujishima and Honda reported photoelectrochemical water splitting is not mentioned in the review.
